candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. candidateAudit.text: Some cities are explored. Vienna is best experienced through its traditions. The Presidential Waltz invites you into the heart of the city's most enduring legacy. Within the magnificent Presidential Suite, private instructors guide you through the graceful movements of the Viennese Waltz, accompanied by the enchanting sounds of live classical music. Here, centuries of imperial tradition become beautifully personal. Every turn, every note, and every step is an invitation to embrace the elegance that has defined Vienna for generations. This is more than a dance lesson. More than a performance. It is a journey into the soul of Vienna, where timeless tradition, exceptional hospitality, and unforgettable moments move in perfect harmony. The Presidential Waltz. Experience Vienna's most iconic tradition - one graceful step at a time. #rcmemories #TheRitzCarltonVienna #vienna #waltz

candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: Every great journey tells a story. This one begins aboard a moving piece of Vienna's history. Step onto a beautifully restored historic tram and watch the city unfold as a Sicilian aperitivo sets the tone for an unforgettable evening. As imperial Vienna glides by, the journey slowly carries you south - to the vibrant flavors, traditions, and spirit of Sicily. Awaiting at the final stop is Pastamara - Bar con Cucina, where the legacy of Ragusa comes to life through an extraordinary dining experience. Every course is a celebration of heritage, craftsmanship, and the unmistakable warmth of Italian hospitality. The Pastamara Express is more than a tram ride. More than an exceptional dinner. It is a journey between two cultures, where the elegance of Vienna meets the soul of Sicily—one unforgettable evening, one remarkable table, one extraordinary experience. #rcmemories #TheRitzCarltonVienna #vienna

candidateAudit.title: Simple Too - Das Kochbuch von Ottolenghi Das Warten hat sich gelohnt🥳 Mit 135 Rezepten von Frühstück bis Dinner bringt ihr neue Impulse von Yotam Ottolenghi direkt in euren Alltag
candidateAudit.text: Simple Too - Das Kochbuch von Ottolenghi Das Warten hat sich gelohnt🥳 Mit 135 Rezepten von Frühstück bis Dinner bringt ihr neue Impulse von Yotam Ottolenghi direkt in euren Alltag. Im Zentrum jedes Rezepts steht die Einfachheit – ob in unter 30 Minuten fertig, in nur einem Topf gekocht oder clever im Voraus vorbereitet. Egal, was euch bisher vom Kochen abgehalten hat – dieses Buch weckt eure Lust darauf und zeigt, dass selbst die simpelsten Gerichte voller Geschmack und Freude stecken können. Wir hätten am liebsten gleich alle Rezepte durchprobiert - werden wir bestimmt auch noch machen. Seit dem Eintreffen des Buches haben wir drei Gerichte nachgekocht: "Menemen", "Persischer Erbsen-Kartoffel-Topf" und "Auberginen mit karamellisierten Datteln und Senfkörnern". Mmmmh! Genau das was wir erwartet haben: einfach, kreativ und unglaublich lecker😋 Wer Ottolenghi kennt und liebt, wird mit dieser Fortsetzung von "Simple" seine reine Freude haben🥰 #kochbuchtipp #kochbuchneuerscheinung #rezeptetest #simpletoo #ottolenghi

candidateAudit.title: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is
candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed way to spend your Saturday evening? Join us for (board) Gayme Night at Villa Vida Café, an evening of games, queer community, and meeting people. 📅 Saturday, 5 September ⏰ 18:00–late 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna Whether you’re a board game enthusiast, an occasional player, or have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, you’re welcome. 🃏♟️🎲 Come by yourself, with a friend, with a partner, or with a whole group. Arriving alone is completely normal—you can join a table and meet people through playing rather than having to make endless small talk. 🌈 What to expect: ✨ Board and card games ✨ Beginner-friendly atmosphere ✨ Queer community & new faces ✨ No need to be competitive ✨ Stay for one game or the whole evening ✨ Bring a favourite game if you want — or simply show up 🌍 Languages: We’re a multilingual community. English and German are commonly spoken, but there’s no required event language. Tables can play in whatever language works for everyone involved. ♿ Accessibility: Villa Vida Café has step-free access and an accessible toilet. The café is non-smoking indoors. Please keep in mind that several games and conversations may happen at once, so the space can become lively and noisy.

candidateAudit.text: Istanbul von Özlem Warren🌞 Özlem Warren gelingt es mit diesem Werk ein weiteres Mal köstliche Rezepte, bereichernde Hintergründe und eine wertige Aufmachung miteinander zu verbinden. Das Ergebnis ist ein intensives kulinarisches Istanbul-Erlebnis. Den Charme des Buches macht neben wissenswerten Geschichten über die multikulturelle und multireligiöse Bosporus-Metroploe auch aus, dass die Rezepte nach Alltagssituationen Istanbuls strukturiert sind. So lauten die Kapitel unter anderem Frühstückscafé, Bäckerei, Handwerkerrestaurants, Streetfood, vom Grill, der Bosporus, Hausmannskost, Bauernmärkte und Konditorei. Die Mehrzahl der Rezepte ist vegan oder vegetarisch. Wir haben zwei davon nachgekocht: "Filoröllchen" und "Manti für Schummler". Die herrlichschmeckenden Filoröllchen haben wir mit unserem Bio Schwarzkümmel aufgehübscht und zu den Manti kam unsere neu im Shop eingetroffene Bio Liptauergewürzmischung. Das passte alles perfekt zusammen😋 Eindeutig ein wundervolles Kochbuch, das auf jeder Seite Freude macht - alle, die kulinarisch weltoffen und neugierig sind, werden begeistert sein! #rezeptetest #neueskochbuch #istanbul #babettesgewürze #özlemwarren

candidateAudit.text: Every city has its treasures. Vienna invites you to create one. Hidden behind the doors of one of the city's most storied ateliers, Vienna's Crystal Stories is an exclusive journey into the world of J. & L. Lobmeyr, where master artisans have transformed crystal into timeless works of art since 1823. Watch centuries of craftsmanship come to life before your eyes as every cut, every engraving, and every detail is shaped with remarkable precision. Here, tradition is not preserved behind glass—it is lived, practiced, and shared. Then, become part of the story yourself. Guided by generations of expertise, create your own personalized crystal keepsake—a piece that carries not only your name, but the spirit of Vienna's enduring legacy of craftsmanship. Some souvenirs remind you where you've been. This one becomes part of who you are. Vienna's Crystal Stories. An experience where heritage is not simply admired—it is held in your hands.

candidateAudit.text: Tahini Baby - Vegetarische Rezepte aus der Levante-Küche von Eden Grinshpan und Rachel Holtzman🌞 Die volle Vielfalt der levantinischen Küche begegnet einem in diesem sehr gelungenen Kochbuch. Die Rezepte reichen von Kleinigkeiten zum Knabbern über Frühstück und Brunch bis zu Salaten, prächtigen Hauptgerichten, Gebäcken und Desserts. Wir haben zwei Rezepte aus dem optisch sehr ansprechend gestalteten Buch voll sinnlicher Foodfotografie nachgekocht: "Halloumi-Salat mit gegrilltem Gemüse und gerösteter Gewürzvinaigrette" sowie "Gewürzte Harissa-Orechiette mit Knoblauch-Tahini". Statt Orechiette haben wir es mit Garofalo versucht und natürlich ließen wir unsere Bio Harissa Gewürzmischung einrieseln. Soooo good! 😋 Die Beschaffung der Zutaten stellte uns vor keine große Herausforderung. Die Rezepte sind einfach bis mittelschwer und eignen sich hervorragend für alle, die Spaß an der Levante-Küche haben. Komm vorbei und überzeuge dich selbst beim Durchblättern🥰 #rezeptetest #kochbuchtipp #levantinischeküche #babettesgewürze #tahinibaby

candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: Zwetschgen-Streuselkuchen mit Apfelstrudelgewürz🍰 Apfelstrudelgewürz mit Zwetschgen? Jaaa, unbedingt😊 Zimt, Nelken, Orangenschale und weitere feine Gewürze, abgerundet durch die herbe Süße von Rohrohrzucker, würzen viele fruchtige Süßspeisen wie das morgendliche Müsli, den Keksteig, ein schnelles Crumble, oder eben einen supersaftigen und flaumigen Zwetschgenkuchen😋 Du brauchst für eine Springform (26cm): 700 g Zwetschgen 120 g Butter, weich 2 Eier, Eiklar und Dotter getrennt 80 g Braunen Rohrzucker 150 g Dinkelmehl 2 TL Backpulver 1 Prise Salz 1 EL Babette's Bio Apfelstrudelgewürz 50 g Sauerrahm 30 gemahlene Haselnüsse Für die Streusel: 50 g Butter 50g Braunen Rohrzucker 100 g Mehl 1 TL Babette's Bio Apfelstrudelgewürz 5 EL gehobelte Mandeln Rosenblütenblätter Lavendelblüten Zubereitung: Die Zwetschgen waschen, halbieren und entkernen. Beiseite stellen. Butter, Eidotter und Zucker mit einem Mixer cremig schlagen. Mehl, Backpulver, Apfelstrudelgewürz und Salz in einer Schüssel gut vermischen und nach und nach in die Ei-Zucker-Butter-Masse einrühren. Dann den Rahm dazurühren, Haselnüsse unterrühren und zum Schluss das zu Schnee geschlagene Eiklar gleichmäßig unterheben. Nun den Teig in eine gefettete, mit Mehl bestäubte Springform geben und die Zwetschgen leicht schräg, dicht an dicht in den Teig stellen. Für die Streusel Butter, Zucker, Gewürz und Mehl mit den Händen grob verkneten, sodass Streusel entstehen. Diese auf den Zwetschgen verteilen. Im vorgeheizten Backofen bei 180°C (Ober-/Unterhitze) 50-60 Minuten backen. Ca 15 Minuten vor Ende der Backzeit gehobelte Mandel

candidateAudit.title: NEW BLOG: Wir stellen vor: Weingut Sommer aus Donnerskirchen. Mit unserem jüngsten Neuzugang zieht es uns wieder einmal ans Leithagebirge. Hier spielt allerdings neben dem Leithaka
candidateAudit.text: NEW BLOG: Wir stellen vor: Weingut Sommer aus Donnerskirchen. Mit unserem jüngsten Neuzugang zieht es uns wieder einmal ans Leithagebirge. Hier spielt allerdings neben dem Leithakalk vor allem der Schieferboden die Hauptrolle. In steilen Höhenlagen wie dem Donnerskirchner Bergweingarten und der Ried Himmelreich stoßen wir auf einen unerwarteten Bekannten: Grünen Veltliner! Leo und Kathrin, die das Familienweingut über die letzten Jahre übernommen haben (und damit uralte Veltliner Bestände in eben genannten Toplagen), beweisen uns Jahr für Jahr das immense Potenzial unserer Nationalrebe im Leithagebirge. Wer „little sister“ und „Salz und Rauch“ noch nicht probiert hat, hat noch nicht gelebt. Mit Neugier und Tatendrang widmen sich die beiden außerdem in ihrer „Handwerk“ Linie der Artenvielfalt des pannonischen Raums, von alten Welsch Parzellen bis zu neuen Experimenten mit Furmint, dem urspätreifenden Somm-Favorit, oder „Chenin des Ostens“, Zitat Autor. ;) Mit ihrem handwerklichen, naturnahen und bedachten Zugang haben sich Leo und Kathrin über wenige Jahre klar an der Spitze der österreichischen Weinwelt gefunden. Und ihr Wein wird jedes Jahr besser. *** BLOG ONLINE *** #pubklemo #winebar #wineshop #austria #leithaberg

candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. candidateAudit.title: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to conne
candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Zutaten für eine Bessere Welt von Kindernothilfe Österreich❤️ Die Kindernothilfe Österreich ist ein gemeinnütziger Verein, der seit 1996 Kindern in den ärmsten Regionen der Welt zu einer besseren Zukunft verhilft. Zum 30-jährigen Jubiläum ist ein besonderes Buch entstanden: eine Mischung aus kulinarischer Entdeckungsreise und Einblicken in weltweite Hilfsprojekte. Zwischen den spannenden und berührenden Geschichten stehen authentische Rezepte aus den Projektländern, gekocht von Projektmitarbeitenden, Kindern und ihren Müttern. Zutatenlisten, Fotos und QR-Codes zu Kochvideos laden zum Nachkochen ein🫕 Wir haben gleich mal zwei Rezepte nachgekocht: "Fatteh - Libanesisches Fladenbrot mit Kichererbsen und Joghurt" und "Kartoffel-Ei-Curry auf indische Art". Beide Gerichte waren schnell und einfach zubereitet und haben uns geschmacklich so überzeugt, dass wir diese vielfältige, kulinarische Reise auf jeden Fall fortsetzen wollen😋 Dieses liebevoll gestaltete, zweisprachige (Deutsch, Englisch) Buch ist mehr als ein Kochbuch: eine kulinarische Weltreise, ein Ausdruck gelebter Solidarität und eine Einladung, über den Tellerrand zu schauen. Mit jedem gekauften Kochbuch werden Kinder und ihre Familien weltweit unterstützt. Mehr unter www.kindernothilfe.at #rezeptetest #nachgekocht #babettesgewürze #kindernothilfeÖsterreich #füreinebesserewelt

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. Whether you’re an experienced strategist, a casual player, or completely new to board games, Gayme Night is all about meeting people, sharing laughs, and enjoying a welcoming queer space. Bring your favourite game or choose from our growing collection of board and card games. Come with friends or come on your own—there’s always a table to join. Event Details 📅 Date: Friday, 29 August 🕕 Time: 18:00–21:00 📍 Location: Villa Vida Café, Vienna 💸 Entry: Free No registration is required. Simply drop by whenever you’d like during the evening. candidateAudit.title: Quinoa mit Zaatar-Feta und Pfirsich😋 Unser Bio Zaatar ist aromatisch, erdig und überraschend wie eine Reise durch den Libanon. Zaatar (auch Zatar, Za’tar, Satar), eigentlich der N
candidateAudit.text: Quinoa mit Zaatar-Feta und Pfirsich😋 Unser Bio Zaatar ist aromatisch, erdig und überraschend wie eine Reise durch den Libanon. Zaatar (auch Zatar, Za’tar, Satar), eigentlich der Name einer Oreganoart, beschreibt auch eine Gewürzmischung die im gesamten arabischen Raum zu Brot und Öl oder Labneh genossen wird. Die Varianten sind regional verschieden - unsere Zaatar Mischung betont die frische Säure der Sumacbeere, die im Libanon sehr beliebt ist. Weil man gerade die herrlichsten Pfirsiche bekommt, haben wir heute ein fruchtig-säuerliches Rezept mit Zaatar für dich😉 Du brauchst für 2 Portionen: 120 g Quinoa, nach Packungsanleitung zubereitet 250 g Feta 1-2 TL Babette's Bio Zaatar 1 großer, saftiger Pfirsich, in dünne, nochmal halbierte Scheiben geschnitten 3 EL Olivenöl 1 kleine, rote Zwiebel, in feine Ringe geschnitten 20 g Petersilie, fein gehackt Etwas Minze, fein gehackt Saft von 1 Zitrone Salz, Pfeffer Pul Biber Zubereitung: Den Backofen auf 200°C Ober-/Unterhitze vorheizen. Den Feta auf ein größeres Stück Alufolie auf ein Backblech legen und mit Zaatar bestreuen. Die Pfirsichstücke rundherum legen und mit 2 Esslöffel Olivenöl übergießen. Nun die Alufolie seitlich hochziehen und zum Verschließen locker zusammendrücken. Das Ganze 20 Minuten backen. Die Zwiebel mit dem restlichen Öl in einer kleinen Pfanne knusprig braten und auf einem Küchenpapier abtropfen lassen. Den Feta aus dem Ofen holen, vorsichtig öffnen und den Backsaft in einer Schüssel mit dem Zitronensaft vermischen. Den Quinoa und die gehackten Kräuter untermischen und mit Salz und Pfeffer abschmecken. Quino

candidateAudit.title: Pasta & Verdura von Cettina Vicenzino🍝🍆🍅🫑 Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, im Bereich der italienischen Kochbücher einen neuen inhaltlichen Zugang zu finden. Cettina Vicenzino, Au
candidateAudit.text: Pasta & Verdura von Cettina Vicenzino🍝🍆🍅🫑 Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, im Bereich der italienischen Kochbücher einen neuen inhaltlichen Zugang zu finden. Cettina Vicenzino, Autorin mehrerer sehr guter italienischer Kochbücher, gelingt das mit diesem Buch jedoch ganz hervorragend. Darin verbindet sie unterschiedliche Pastaformen und Gemüse zu spannenden Gerichten, von denen nicht alle so konsequent italienisch sind, wie man vielleicht denken könnte. Darüber hinaus liest und erfährt man enorm viel Wissenswertes: Zu Pastasorten, klassischen Pasta-Teigen, lernt bunte Teige (blau!) kennen, ebenso glutenfreie Teige und alles, was man zum Ausrollen, Aufbewahren, zu Zutaten und Ausrüstung wissen muss. Die 80 zu rund 99% vegetarischen Rezepte sind nach den vier Jahreszeiten geordnet. Sehr sinnvoll, da es ja um Gemüse geht. Wir haben aus dem ästhetisch und sinnlich gestalteten Buch zwei Rezepte ausprobiert: "Kräuter-Orzo-Risotto mit Stracciatella" und "Pasta mit Dreierlei Tomaten - Geröstet, getrocknet, frisch". Beide Gerichte waren recht schnell am Tisch und haben hervorragend geschmeckt. Aber nicht nur, weil Pasta "einfach ist" und "immer geht", sondern weil es Cettina immer wieder schafft in ihren Rezepten einen Hauch von Wärme, Liebe und Lebenslust zu übermitteln, was sich automatisch auf Koch/Köchin und Gerichte überträgt❤️ Wer italienische Küche und Pasta mag, wird dieses Buch lieben. Egal, ob Einsteiger oder intimer Italien-Kenner😊 Du kennst bereits Cettina's Kochbücher? Welches ist dein Lieblings Gericht aus welchem Buch von ihr? Schreib uns gerne in den Kommentaren🥰 #

candidateAudit.text: 2.185 € für Venezuela. ❤️🇻🇪 Dank eurer unglaublichen Unterstützung konnten wir in den letzten Tagen 2.185 € sammeln. Mit diesem Geld kaufen wir weitere dringend benötigte Sachspenden, die gemeinsam mit unserem Container nach Venezuela geschickt werden. Ein riesiges Dankeschön an den javaneh.verein Verein, josephavilag sowie alle Künstlerinnen und Künstler, die ihre Werke für das Benefizevent #WienHilftVenezuela gespendet haben. ❤️ Ebenso bedanken wir uns bei den viennavikings , dem hrcvienna , fiestaviena und cellavie_aviation_club für ihre wertvolle Unterstützung. Unser Container füllt sich jeden Tag ein Stück mehr und das ist nur dank euch möglich. 📦 Kennt ihr Unternehmen, Vereine oder Organisationen, die unsere Hilfsaktion unterstützen möchten? Dann teilt diesen Beitrag und helft uns, noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen. Jede Unterstützung zählt. Danke von Herzen. 🇦🇹🤝🇻🇪 #ErdbebenHilfe #Wien #Spenden #Venezuela

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A per
candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.title: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a
candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

candidateAudit.text: Cappuccino dopo le 12? Cappuccino nach 12 Uhr? 🇦🇹 Warum trinkt man in Italien nachmittags keinen Cappuccino? ☕ Cappuccino wurde als Frühstücksgetränk erfunden, oft mit Croissant, um morgens Energie zu geben. 🥛 Milch gilt als „schweres“ Lebensmittel: Nach dem Mittagessen ist Espresso leichter und fördert die Verdauung. 🍴 Cappuccino morgens, Espresso nach den Mahlzeiten: eine ungeschriebene Regel der italienischen Kultur. 🌍 Im Ausland trinkt man Cappuccino zu jeder Tageszeit, in Italien hingegen ist er ein Symbol für Frühstück und Alltagskultur. ⸻ 🇮🇹 Perché in Italia non si beve cappuccino dopo mezzogiorno? ☕ Il cappuccino nasce come bevanda da colazione, spesso con brioche, per dare energia al mattino. 🥛 Il latte è considerato “pesante”: dopo pranzo meglio un espresso, più leggero e digestivo. 🍴 Cappuccino al mattino, espresso dopo i pasti: è una regola non scritta della cultura italiana. 🌍 All’estero si beve cappuccino a ogni ora, ma in Italia è simbolo di colazione e tradizione quotidiana. #wien #15district #italienischespezialität #capuccino #coffeebreak #dalpirata #italianfoodlover #italy #dolcevita

candidateAudit.title: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdie
candidateAudit.text: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdienten Ruhestand verabschiedet und das süße Eck vertrauensvoll in unsere Hände gelegt. Wir sind Nicole Heinrich und Raphaela Mastella und vielleicht kennen uns manche von euch als Backterium, das ist unsere 10 Jahre alte Auftragskonditorei. Einige Kunden durften wir in den letzten Wochen bereits persönlich kennenlernen und dabei schon einiges über eure Lieblingsprodukte lernen, die wir natürlich weiterhin im Sortiment haben werden. Schließlich soll niemand auf seine Trüffelkugeln, Lieblingslakritze, Schichtnougat oder lieb gewonnenes Blockmalz verzichten müssen. Trotzdem dürft ihr gespannt auf ein paar süsse Sortimentserweiterungen sein. Den Juli und Anfang August werden wir gut nutzen um uns in unserem neuen Zuhause einzurichten und für euch vorzukosten damit wir mit 26. August persönlich für euch da sein können. Wer sich, verständlicherweise, die Wartezeit versüßen möchte, kann sich gerne in unserem Webshop mit den nötigen Grundnaschungsmitteln versorgen. Infos zur Eröffnung erhaltet ihr natürlich rechtzeitig in einem eigenen Eck-strablatt. Bis bald, Eure süßen Eck-sperten Raphaela und Nicole
